# Security reporting

Do not report vulnerabilities, exploit details, credentials, or private data in
public GitHub issues. Use the repository's
[private vulnerability report](https://github.com/nerymurillohnd/codex-essentials/security/advisories/new)
to send details to the maintainer. Include the affected plugin, version, Codex
host, reproduction steps, and impact without exposing unrelated secrets.

If the private reporting form is unavailable, do not open a public issue with
sensitive details. The maintainer must enable or repair private vulnerability
reporting before the new `main` is published.
